title: MemoryTrace
description: An auditable, lossless trace of one memory operation (write or recall) through a provider behind a Baltor wrapper. Records the provider used, the (tenant_id, container) scope, the artifacts touched, and the held-out/rejected sets so the operation is reproducible and reversible. Lossless distillation: held_out and rejected are PRESERVED here, never deleted; a rollback_target is always recorded so no transform is irreversible. A trace asserts nothing about canonical truth — it only proves what was remembered/recalled, by whom, from where, and how to roll it back.

operation.description: The memory operation traced. 'promote' is recorded ONLY when the downstream gates promoted a candidate; the provider/wrapper never sets it on its own.

request_handle.description: Hash/ref of the originating request (write/search) for replay.

produced_artifact_ids.description: Candidate MemoryArtifact ids produced by this operation.

held_out_artifact_ids.description: Artifacts deliberately NOT served. Preserved (held_out != deleted).

rejected_artifact_ids.description: Artifacts rejected by a gate. Preserved for audit (rejected != deleted).

rollback_target.description: The state/artifact id this operation can be rolled back to. Always recorded.
